narrative.overview: This visual system frames Lục Văn Sơn's (ShadyFyrix / BetterCallShady) personal landing page as an open, full-viewport Three.js WebGL 3D universe rather than a boxed card template. A persistent fixed WebGL canvas renders a deep abyssal horizon, an infinite undulating GLSL perspective energy grid, 2,200 magnetic particles, and interactive 3D centerpieces directly behind translucent obsidian content surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent full-viewport Three.js WebGL stage with GLSL infinite perspective grid, magnetic particles, and scroll-choreographed 3D camera flight.
Single-elevation translucent obsidian rim surfaces with pointer-tracked specular sheen and zero hard offset shadows.
Custom vector ShadyFyrix cyan-rimmed cube emblem unifying the favicon suite, navigation bar, and interactive 3D hero centerpiece.
Strictly solid high-contrast display typography (Unbounded + Be Vietnam Pro) with zero kickers and zero gradient text.

rules.name: The Impulse-Only Ember Rule
rules.body: Solar Ember (#ff6a45) appears only on active pressed states, audio shockwaves, and FFT peaks — never as a static background fill or general link color.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rim Rule
rules.body: Surfaces declare elevation once through a crisp 1px translucent rim and pointer specular sheen, never combining borders with diffuse drop shadows or hard offset block shadows.

rules.name: The Zero-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings stand on their own scale and weight — never place small uppercase eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.

rules.name: The Honest-Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono applies strictly to numeric readouts, timestamps, years, and code/stack identifiers — never to Vietnamese prose sentences or role titles.

dos: Do keep text contrast >= 4.5:1 (#f2f6ff and #b7c6e0 over obsidian surfaces) even when luminous WebGL shaders animate underneath.
Do trigger WebGL shockwaves or subtle core modulation cleanly via SpatialContext refs so 60 FPS animations cause zero React re-renders.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by freezing continuous spin/camera drift while preserving crisp static 3D rendering and instant state feedback.
Do keep all real personal data, live API endpoints, and .ogg audio samples strictly user-initiated and truthful.
donts: Don't add eyebrow/kicker tags above headings, gradient text fills, feTurbulence noise overlays, or hard offset shadows (6px 6px 0).
Don't expose the student ID (2310900087) in visible page copy or commit STEAM_API_KEY into client assets.
Don't apply monospace styling to Vietnamese prose descriptions or role titles.
Don't stack decorative blur boxes over flat opaque surfaces where no live WebGL depth exists underneath.
